protocol.boundary: client HTTP dispatch/arrival to completed stream
protocol.connections: fresh TCP connection per call; no transparent retries
protocol.arrival_latency: includes client admission delay in poisson mode
protocol.throughput_denominator: entire measured point including fill/drain and failed calls
protocol.input_throughput: prompt tokens / whole point; not isolated prefill speed
protocol.tpot: (last token event - first token event) / (output tokens - 1)
protocol.chunking: client-observed; coalesced tokens have a shared arrival timestamp
protocol.warmup: separate requests excluded from measurement; run before every point

warnings: fewer than two waves of requests; fill/drain effects can dominate

settings.multimodal_initialization: engine default; text token-ID requests only
